name: Beau-Rivage Palace
insider_take: This Belle Époque palace on Lake Geneva's shores has been the epitome of Swiss luxury since 1861, where royalty, celebrities, and discerning travelers have found their lakeside sanctuary.
whats_special: The hotel sits on 10 acres of manicured gardens with direct lake access and its own private beach. The property features three Michelin-recognized restaurants, including the acclaimed Anne-Sophie Pic au Beau-Rivage Palace, making it a rare destination where world-class dining meets stunning Alpine scenery. The palace also houses Switzerland's largest hotel spa at 1,500 square meters.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view suite during the Montreux Jazz Festival season (July) when many performers stay at the hotel, or visit during the Festival de la Cité when Lausanne transforms into an open-air theater.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's private boat to explore Lake Geneva, visit the nearby Olympic Museum (Lausanne is the Olympic Capital), and experience the UNESCO-listed Lavaux vineyard terraces just 15 minutes away. The hotel's historic Rotonde bar offers vintage cocktails with panoramic lake views that have enchanted guests for over a century.
pros: Stunning lakefront location on Lake Geneva with panoramic alpine views
Historic Belle Époque palace with elegant Swiss hospitality and timeless charm
World-class spa and wellness facilities with luxurious treatments
Multiple award-winning restaurants including Michelin-starred dining options
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
